jobs.description:
TYTAN Technologies

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.

We are looking for an Experienced Strategic Procurement Engineer to take ownership of our procurement strategy and operations as we scale. This role combines strategic procurement, technical expertise, supplier management, and cross-functional execution. You will work closely with the Manufacturing team, Engineering, Quality, Finance, Operations, and Legal to build a resilient, cost-effective, and scalable supply base.

This role is Ideal for someone with a strong ownership mentality, technical understanding, and proven track record of high performance.

Your Roadmap to Make an Impact

Procurement Strategy & Supplier Management

- Develop and execute sourcing strategies for key commodities, components, and services.
- Select, onboard, and manage global suppliers, building long-term strategic partnerships.
- Take ownership of strategic suppliers and sourcing projects from selection through ongoing performance management.
- Monitor supplier performance and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
- Build and continuously develop a scalable and resilient supplier base.

Cost, Risk & Contract Management

- Lead cost reduction, value engineering, and commercial optimization initiatives in collaboration with Engineering and Manufacturing.
- Lead supplier negotiations for contracts, pricing, and commercial agreements.
- Identify, manage, and mitigate supply chain and supplier risks through effective contingency and risk mitigation plans.
- Balance cost, quality, technical requirements, lead times, and scalability when making procurement decisions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Act as the procurement interface to Manufacturing, Engineering, Finance, Quality, Operations, and Legal for selected commodities and projects.
- Work closely with Engineering to understand technical requirements, products, specifications, and cost drivers.
- Support new product introductions, industrialization, supplier readiness, and production ramp-ups.
- Coordinate procurement activities across teams to ensure material availability and timely execution.
- Proactively identify bottlenecks, align stakeholders, and drive topics through to completion.

Operational Ownership & Process Improvement

- Take ownership of procurement priorities and ensure effective work distribution, follow-up, and execution.
- Support procurement processes and KPI reporting.
- Maintain supplier documentation, contracts, and relevant procurement data.
- Contribute to procurement system and process improvements as TYTAN scales.
- Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and strengthen procurement operations.

Job requirements

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
- 3 - 6 years of experience in strategic procurement, sourcing, or supply chain, preferably in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
- Engineering background, ideally Mechanical or Industrial Engineering, with a strong understanding of technical products and manufacturing processes.
- Proven experience managing strategic suppliers, negotiations, and complex sourcing initiatives.
- Experience with NPI, production ramp-ups, and scaling operations.
- Strong analytical, commercial, and stakeholder management skills.
- High sense of ownership, structured working style, and hands-on mindset.
- Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively across Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Finance, Quality, and Legal.
- Experience with ERP and procurement systems (e.g. SAP) is a plus.
- Fluent English and German skills are required

Why TYTAN?

- Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security
- Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale
- Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors
- Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback
- Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact
- Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company
- Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

- Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through Virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation
- Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit
- Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us
- Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team
- Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together
- Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands
- Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

Specialist Regulatory Stewardship – Chemical Compliance & Global Inventories (f, m, d)

Project Iris is an applied research initiative dedicated to automated spatial data analysis, land registry intelligence, sustainable infrastructure mapping, and open-source resilience modeling. 

To ensure long-term independence and funding for non-profit research, Project Iris works with an established commercial transfer network (including RE-Managers GmbH). Through this framework, proprietary data algorithms, geospatial scoring models, and automation tools are licensed and deployed across real-world commercial sectors (e.g., real estate, institutional investments, infrastructure providers, and SME enterprise solutions).

- Marketing & Value Proposition Communication: Create structured presentation decks, use-case briefs, and digital campaign materials to position our data products in commercial and public markets.

- Strong interest in technology, spatial data, AI platforms, or digital business models.

- Mindset: Proactive, structured, and comfortable working at the intersection of non-profit research and commercial markets. 
- Eligibility: Open to local and international applicants currently in Germany (e.g., Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card, Job-Seeker Visa, EU Work Permit).

Send your CV, references, and your earliest possible start date to:

Target Group: Software Engineers, Data Engineers, Full-Stack Developers, Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) Holders, and Master’s Graduates 

About Project Iris 

Project Iris is an applied research and technology initiative dedicated to automated spatial data analysis, cadastre intelligence, infrastructure mapping, and open-source data modeling. 

Together with our commercial transfer network (including RE-Managers GmbH), we bridge the gap between academic data science, resilience research, and practical real-world application. Complex geospatial and resilience data models are deployed into active enterprise environments, stakeholder portals, and infrastructure tools. The resulting real-world usage and performance metrics are continuously validated and fed back into our open research models. 

In this role, you turn algorithmic frameworks and spatial datasets into robust, production-ready digital architectures. 

Your Focus & Responsibilities 

- Geospatial & Core Data Modeling: Develop and refine automated pipelines for spatial datasets, open-source cadastre records, and environmental scoring algorithms using Python. 
- AI-Assisted Full-Stack Integration: Transform algorithmic logic into high-performance FastAPI backends and connect them with modern React/Next.js frontends (leveraging cutting-edge tools such as v0.dev, Cursor, and Windsurf). 
- Applied Transfer & Enterprise Workflows: Implement real-world pilot applications by connecting data models to practical workflows (e.g., automated property screening, municipal portals, and ERP/Odoo interface connections for infrastructure). 
- Multi-Tenant Architecture & Cloud Deployment: Package services into robust Docker multi-container environments and deploy them on secure European/Swiss server infrastructure (Infomaniak VPS) with strict Row-Level Security (RLS) and data privacy standards. 
- Continuous Feedback Architecture: Establish data pipelines that capture operational feedback from commercial deployments to refine and advance the research models. 

What We Are Looking For 

- Technical Background: Degree in Computer Science, Geoinformatics, Software Engineering, Data Science, or equivalent practical industry experience. 
- Core Technical Skills: 
- Solid programming foundation in Python (FastAPI, Pandas, data handling) and/or modern Web technologies (TypeScript, React, Next.js). 
- Working knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL) and containerization (Docker / Docker Compose). 
- Practical experience or strong interest in AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, v0.dev, LLM APIs). 
- Mindset: Strong analytical curiosity, proactive problem-solving attitude, and a clean-code engineering approach. 
- Eligibility: Open to local applicants and international candidates currently in Germany (e.g., Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card, Job-Seeker Visa, or EU Work Permit).
